status: post-adjudication saved-data sensitivity; settings recorded before execution, not a preregistration or confirmation
seed_rule: SHA256(label) first8bytes big-endian XOR base_seed, modulo 2**63-1; labels dirichlet:alpha={alpha:g}, bootstrap:s2a, bootstrap:s2p
estimand: equal-weight average of sixteen fixed prompt latent high-minus-low condition means, separately for s2a and s2p
dirichlet: Independent symmetric Dirichlet(alpha,alpha,alpha) priors for each prompt-condition probabilities over episode outcomes {0,.5,1}; posterior counts+alpha; independent condition draws; central95% marginal credible intervals per contrast, not simultaneous confidence intervals
bootstrap: Existing two-stage scheme extended to paired contrast: resample16 prompt indices with replacement, preserving same prompt at high/low; independently resample6 empirical episodes per selected prompt per condition; average high-low. Central95% percentile intervals. Exploratory hypothetical-generator target, no random-sampling design or coverage guarantee; empirical corners remain point masses.
verification: Check exact source counts/n=6/16prompts, observed contrasts; compare Monte Carlo means/variances to independently computed analytic posterior and bootstrap moments; cross-check category totals and independently recorded condition means from frozen variance summary; no raw DB access; record every alpha and both contrasts including zero-excluded outcomes
execution_limits: Existing cached NumPy/SciPy only, no installs/network/providers/subjects/optimizer changes; process CPU limit240seconds, total<=300seconds; one planned numerical execution, no selective reruns
scope_limits: Conditional independence across episodes/prompt-cells is assumed for posterior; no latent-person invariance or general human claim; no new registered scientific result
